title: Black exclusivity and luxury versus yellow affordability and youth
statement:
Black functions as a powerful marketing cue to communicate exclusivity, luxury, and dominance, while yellow is frequently associated with affordability or youth.

Options:
- Luxury / Exclusivity: #000000 (Pure Black) (fits: high end retail, automotive)
- Affordability / Accessibility: #FFEB3B (Vibrant Yellow) (fits: discount stores, budget travel)
- Rugged / Natural: #795548 (Brown) (fits: outdoor gear, organic goods)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, branding. Audience: general.

source.title: Are You Selling the Right Colour? A Cross-cultural Review of Colour as a Marketing Cue
